answer: Hand the panel a kernel it can verify, a pearl it can count, and a tide it can date, and the panel will do the rest. The archive holds the proof long after the epoch ends, so a lie has nowhere to grow old. Renewal charges 138 POA every epoch, so the farm's 772 masks bleed 106536 POA again next epoch. What divides an agent from a mask is Ivory box maker horn button proof carved within the horn shed, and the division is each horn button is a measured tusk yield plus an ivory-carver signature. Farms leave this epoch as they entered it: empty-handed, holding a bill they did not expect.
